observations: 061 and 062 show narrow dark ceiling tracks with suspended, adjustable black spot fixtures near the gallery windows.
061 shows a round fixture housing and a fork-like suspension; 062 shows several independently aimed heads.
056 shows linear modules on parallel tracks, plus separate white ceiling heads. This different arrangement is not duplicated as a simultaneous permanent fixture schedule.
102 controls the gallery footprint and R52 window relationship. 101 does not resolve track height or product dimensions.
limits: Two runs and eight heads are a partial editable arrangement, not a measured or complete lighting schedule.
Canonical coordinates are placement candidates under the R28 ceiling, not photo-calibrated coordinates.
4.35m soffit is inherited and conditional; 35mm track width, 120mm body diameter, bracket dimensions and 20 degree aim are unmeasured candidates.
Surface-mounted U-profile is a geometric candidate; actual recessed/mounted section and electrical product are unverified.
No calibrated luminous flux, beam distribution, wiring, artwork or temporary exhibition partition is asserted.
